questions.question: Identify the correct form of the sentence using inversion to emphasize the adverbial phrase. The committee discussed the proposal after they had received all the feedback.
options: After they had received all the feedback, the proposal was discussed by the committee.
After all the feedback received, the committee discussed the proposal.
After receiving all the feedback, discussed the committee the proposal.
After they received all the feedback, the committee discussed the proposal.
questions.answer: After they had received all the feedback, the proposal was discussed by the committee.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a cleft sentence to emphasize the location? The explorers found the ancient ruins in the dense jungle.
options: It was in the dense jungle that the explorers found the ancient ruins.
The dense jungle was where the explorers found the ancient ruins.
The ancient ruins were found by the explorers in the dense jungle.
In the dense jungle, the explorers found the ancient ruins was the discovery.
questions.answer: It was in the dense jungle that the explorers found the ancient ruins.

questions.question: Select the correct form of the conditional sentence expressing an unreal present situation. If I were you, I would have declined the offer.
options: If I were you, I would have declined the offer.
If I was you, I would have declined the offer.
If I had been you, I would decline the offer.
If I had been you, I would have declined the offer.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would have declined the offer.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical wish? We suggest that the government take immediate action to address the crisis.
options: We suggest that the government takes immediate action to address the crisis.
We suggest that the government taking immediate action to address the crisis.
We suggest that the government took immediate action to address the crisis.
We suggest that the government take immediate action to address the crisis.
questions.answer: We suggest that the government take immediate action to address the crisis.

questions.question: Identify the correct sentence with ellipsis, maintaining grammatical coherence. The committee members present at the meeting included the chairperson, the secretary, and the treasurer.
options: The committee members present at the meeting included the chairperson, the secretary, and the treasurer.
The committee members present at the meeting included the chairperson, the secretary, and the treasurer being.
The committee members present at the meeting included the chairperson, the secretary, and the treasurer were.
The committee members present at the meeting included the chairperson, the secretary, and the treasurer had.
questions.answer: The committee members present at the meeting included the chairperson, the secretary, and the treasurer.
